name: Instant Knowledge Base – Create AI Supported Knowledge Base, Documentation, Wiki, and Help Center
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Instant Knowledge Base is an all-in-one WordPress plugin to create and manage an AI-powered knowledge base, wiki, internal documentation, or FAQ support center in just a few clicks. It’s designed for businesses, SaaS platforms, service providers, product developers, and anyone who needs to provide instant answers to customers, team members, or users.

✅ From structured articles to live AJAX search, feedback voting, and mobile responsiveness — this plugin brings everything you need to build a modern self-service support system.

Create and manage your documentation, FAQs, and help center — all within WordPress. Instant Knowledge Base empowers you to reduce support tickets, enhance customer satisfaction, and scale your support operations — even while you sleep.

✅ Fast, Flexible, and Fully Integrated
Built to work with any WordPress theme, Instant Knowledge Base offers a seamless experience for both administrators and users. Whether you’re supporting customers or onboarding team members, your knowledge base is just a click away.

LIVE DEMO:

DEMO

🚀 Core Features

✔ Modern, Responsive Layout – Sleek, mobile-friendly design that adapts perfectly to any device.
✔ Custom Post Type for Articles – Easily create and manage structured knowledge base content.
✔ Help Topic (Category) Organization – Group articles into logical topics for intuitive navigation.
✔ Real-Time AJAX Search & Filters – Instant, dynamic results without page reloads.
✔ Shortcode Support ([instant_knowledgebase]) – Seamlessly embed your full knowledge base anywhere on your site.
✔ Pre-Built Layouts – Professionally designed templates that integrate smoothly with your theme.
✔ User Role Access Control – Limit visibility to logged-in users or specific roles with flexible settings.
✔ Global & Per-Article Access Settings – Set access permissions globally, or override them at the article level.
✔ Customizable Settings Panel – Tailor layout, behavior, and access controls to fit your needs.
✔ Most Viewed Articles – Automatically feature your most-read content to guide users.
✔ Related Articles Section – Encourage deeper engagement with relevant content suggestions.
✔ Like/Dislike Feedback System – Collect user sentiment to gauge article helpfulness.
✔ Custom Icons for Help Topics – Add icons to topics for better visual organization.
✔ Mobile-Optimized Experience – Flawless performance and readability on all screen sizes.

sections.installation:
You can install the Instant Knowledgebase plugin in three ways:

🔌 Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Instant Knowledge base”.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

💻 Manual Installation via FTP:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from the WordPress.org plugin page or here.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the folder instant-knowledgebase to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory using FTP or your hosting file manager.
  4. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins and click Activate.

🧩 Upload via WordPress Admin:

  1. Download the ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file, click Install Now, and then click Activate.

Once activated:
– Navigate to Knowledge Base > Settings to configure options.
– Create a page and insert the shortcode [instant_knowledgebase] to display the knowledge base on your site.
sections.faq:
How do I display the knowledge base on my site?

Use the [instant_knowledgebase] shortcode on any WordPress page or post to display the knowledge base.

Can I restrict access to certain users?

Yes. You can enable user-role restrictions from Settings > Knowledge Base to control who can view articles.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, it is fully responsive and optimized for smartphones and tablets.

Can I customize the look and feel?

Absolutely. You can apply custom CSS or override the plugin’s templates to match your site’s branding.

Does it include article analytics?

Yes. Built-in view counters and a like/dislike feedback system help track user engagement.

Can I import or export articles?

Yes. The plugin includes import/export functionality for easy backup and transfer of knowledge base content.

Can I change the terms “Articles” and “Categories”?

Yes. You can rename “Articles” to “Knowledge Base” and “Categories” to “Help Topics” in the settings.

How do I organize articles?

Articles can be grouped using help topics (formerly categories) for better organization and navigation.

Can I control access per article?

Yes. You can set access permissions globally or override them on a per-article basis.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin provides options to retain or remove data, giving you more control during uninstallation.
